news.text: WE ARE BACK!#Milan and #Juve into the international break at -2 and -3 from the top.#Pulisic, #Rabiot and #Moreira on target. #Amorim ignites San Siro against #Lecce.#Spalletti also gets back on track. #Sarri and #Atalanta are already lagging behind. Shame at the StadiumThe bianconero curva turn their backs during the tribute to Mazzola.The club's condemnation: "unjustifiable"The section of the Stadium holding the #Juve ultras with their backs turned during the minute of silence for Mazzola. The funeral of the ex interista will take place today in Milan.[Front Page Gazzetta dello Sport]

LUCIO, IT SEEMS REAL#Juve is growing#Spalletti wins 2-0 against la Dea, #Amorim is back on track and wins 3-0 against #Lecce.#Atalanta sunk but #Sarri accuses. #Milan wakes up.#Conceição and #Bremer score: first place is at -3. Mau: "The hold by #Kalulu on #Rowe was not punished. If VAR doesn't intervene, then it's better to abolish it". Shame at the Stadium: the bianconero ultras with their backs turned during the minute of silence in memory of Mazzola. #Pulisic opens the score, then the goals by #Rabiot and #Moreira: top at -2.[Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

"#JUVE BROTHERS"#Conceição and #Bremer score, but the best on the pitch against #Atalanta is #Kolo who thanks everyone for the support.The Frenchman doesn't find the goal, but saves one and plays incredibly all over the pitch. #Spalletti praises him as well Chico: "It's hard to mark me..." #Sarri and the denied penalty: "VAR should be abolished". Shame to the ultras: backs to the pitch and chants during the moment of silence for Mazzola, the club condemns it. #Neto on the way?[Front Page TuttoSport]

🗣 Francisco #Conceicao to 'DAZN': "Celebration? I hit the post twice and on the third time it had to go in. I am a forward and I want to score goals, it is important for a forward. But the most important thing is winning and that is what we did against a strong team".[@juventusinsidernews]

🗣 Francisco #Conceicao to 'DAZN': "Role? I want to become as complete as possible, playing in the center and on the sides of the pitch, that way it is harder for the others because they don't know where I am. I have to do a bit of everything, helping out in front and at the back. I think that today you don't win if you don't play as a team".[@juventusinsidernews]
🗣 Francisco #Conceicao to 'DAZN': "1000 goals for #Spalletti? That way he remembers me. We have to keep going like this because it is important".[@juventusinsidernews]
🗣 Randal #KoloMuani to 'DAZN': "Decisive on the saved goal? It's just a matter of mentality, I was there and we are like brothers on the pitch".[@juventusinsidernews]

🗣 Randal #KoloMuani to 'DAZN': "Is everyone on the #KoloMuani bandwagon, including #Spalletti? Yes, I have to score goals, sometimes it happens, sometimes it doesn't, but I am happy when the team wins and I give everything on the pitch".[@juventusinsidernews]
🗣 Randal #KoloMuani to 'DAZN': "Do I feel the trust? Yes, I am happy. As for the performance we put on today, everyone together gave everything on the pitch".[@juventusinsidernews]

🗣 Gleison #Bremer to 'DAZN': "Am I the third Brazilian in #Juventus history for goals? The important thing is to be doing well physically, that's what I put in my head when I was on vacation, I had little vacation time, I was always working and thinking about this season. I need to be physically fit, if I am physically fit everything is much easier".[@juventusinsidernews]

🗣 Gleison #Bremer to 'DAZN': "An authoritative performance, like a real team? Yes, of course, we are growing, we need to have a bit of patience with the new arrivals, it is never easy. We are building something for the future and I hope we can win in the future. But it all starts from here".[@juventusinsidernews]
Bremer is the Panini Player of the Match! #JuveAtalanta[Serie A]

12 - Since his debut with #Juventus (2022/23), #Bremer is the defender who has scored the highest number of headed goals in the five major European leagues: 12, one more than Virgil #vanDijk. Dominant.#JuventusAtalanta[Opta Paolo]
